purpose: Hand-only correction of palm placement, thumb opposition, and mirrored three-finger full closure for the frozen simple doll proxy

geometry_candidates.name: INTERMEDIATE_PLUSH_PROXY
geometry_candidates.semantics: componentwise midpoint between the previously validated compressed proxy and the frozen visible envelope

geometry_candidates.name: VISUAL_MATCHED_PLUSH_PROXY
geometry_candidates.semantics: rigid plush approximation whose collision envelope matches but never exceeds the frozen visible envelope

material.name: MODERATE_HIGH_FRICTION_COMPRESSED_PLUSH_PROXY_V1
material.contact_damping_source: rigid-body linear/angular damping and damped Dex3 implicit drive

articulation_solver.selection_basis: bounded pre-EVAL enforcement audit: source 32/1 and 64/4 failed the reproduced no-doll B01 hand-table impulse; 80/4, 96/4, and 128/4 passed. The lowest tested passing 80/4 setting was selected to minimize deviation from the previously qualified physical dynamics and was then required to pass the complete non-EVAL qualification.
articulation_solver.scope: common G1 articulation; identical for ACT-A and ACT-B

hand_only_change_provenance.initial_failure: fixed S0 placement produced one-sided middle contact and lateral expulsion for all allowed short axes
hand_only_change_provenance.reason: P8 is an existing policy-independent mirrored three-digit top-power closure with prior bilateral rigid-proxy evidence
hand_only_change_provenance.p9_result: raising the palm produced three sustained on-table contacts but released all contacts at lift onset; it disproved vertical placement as the overlap correction
hand_only_change_provenance.p10_change: restore the P8 load-retaining height, translate each palm 12 mm outward along the doll long axis to clear the OPEN middle-link overlap, and retain the mirrored 0.100 rad middle_1 preload
hand_only_change_provenance.p10_result: static outward placement reduced initial penetration from 11.4 mm to 1.9 mm and lifted the doll, but weakened centered enclosure and yielded only 38.0 mm COM rise
hand_only_change_provenance.p11_change: OPEN 15 mm outward, mirrored approach to the original centered load-retaining palm during PRESHAPE, then fixed palm through three-finger FULL CLOSE
hand_only_change_provenance.p11_result: zero spawn penetration and stable elevated three-digit contact, but middle preload began only after takeoff and the doll settled 11.7 mm within the enclosure
hand_only_change_provenance.p12_change: add exactly 0.100 rad mirrored middle_1 FULL-CLOSE preload; no palm or doll change
hand_only_change_provenance.p12_result: artifact-free sustained elevated three-digit retention; 39.6 mm doll COM rise for 50 mm declared palm travel due takeoff settling
hand_only_change_provenance.p13_change: raise the common mirrored palm center 5 mm into the measured interval between load-retaining P12 and three-contact P9; command 63 mm palm travel so the retained doll COM, rather than the actuator target, reaches at least 50 mm
hand_only_change_provenance.p13_result: 56.5 mm COM lift and 1.0 s elevated retention; middle collider remained touching at zero normal load before lift
hand_only_change_provenance.p14_change: add 0.050 rad mirrored middle_1 preload and increase mirrored OPEN retreat from 15 to 18 mm; no other change

scripted_arm_placement.center_source: palm center translated onto each unchanged doll center; z offset and top-power orientation inherited from prior bilateral P8 validation
